message.realisticsurvival.sick: That water made you sick. Boil it next time.
message.realisticsurvival.cold: You're freezing. Get to a fire or put on warm clothes.
message.realisticsurvival.hot: You're overheating. Find shade and drink.
message.realisticsurvival.broken_leg: You broke your leg! Craft a splint.
message.realisticsurvival.need_axe: You can't get logs by hand. Make a flint hatchet.
realisticsurvival.configuration.title: Flint & Fire
realisticsurvival.configuration.workTire: Hard work makes you hungry and thirsty
message.realisticsurvival.pot_boiling: The water will boil if the pot sits on a lit campfire or fire.
Kindling catches the first spark: plant fibre, fibre string, paper, wheat, dry grass, ferns or dead bushes. A fire starter is the best.
gui.realisticsurvival.campfire.fuel.tip: Fuel keeps it burning: sticks, planks, logs or coal. Logs last a couple of minutes, a fire starter four, coal much longer.
gui.realisticsurvival.campfire.small.tip: A small fire: half the fuel, a little warmth close by, cooks slowly. Rain puts it out easily.
gui.realisticsurvival.campfire.medium.ti: A medium fire: normal fuel use, warms you within about 5 blocks.
gui.realisticsurvival.campfire.large.tip: A large fire: burns fuel 2.5x as fast, warms you from 7 blocks, cooks twice as fast, lots of smoke. Don't stand in it.
gui.realisticsurvival.campfire.light.tip: Light it with a hand drill, bow drill, flint and steel or a flint striker from your inventory. Needs kindling and fuel. A fire starter as kindling makes it easier.
gui.realisticsurvival.lighting.title: Light the fire
gui.realisticsurvival.lighting.hint: Space or click when the spark is in the glow
gui.realisticsurvival.lighting.wet: It's raining: the tinder is damp
message.realisticsurvival.campfire.wet: It's soaked. It won't light in water.
message.realisticsurvival.campfire.no_ki: Add kindling first: plant fibre, paper or dry grass.
message.realisticsurvival.campfire.no_fu: Add fuel first: sticks, logs or coal.
message.realisticsurvival.campfire.no_st: You need a hand drill, bow drill, flint and steel or a flint striker to light it.
message.realisticsurvival.campfire.faile: The tinder didn't catch. Try again.
realisticsurvival.configuration.treeFell: Trees fall when you cut through the trunk
message.realisticsurvival.oven.complete: The brick oven is complete. Light the fires and right-click a wall to work.
message.realisticsurvival.oven.cold: The oven is cold. Light the campfires inside.
message.realisticsurvival.oven.broken: The oven isn't whole any more.
message.realisticsurvival.oven.missing.w: Not an oven yet: an oven wall is missing on layer %s (4x4 walls, 5 high).
message.realisticsurvival.oven.missing.d: Not an oven yet: leave a 2-wide opening in the middle of the front, layers 2 and 3 (layer %s is blocked).
message.realisticsurvival.oven.missing.f: Not an oven yet: the floor inside must be gravel (layer %s).
message.realisticsurvival.oven.missing.c: Not an oven yet: put two campfires along the back inside, on the gravel (layer %s).
message.realisticsurvival.oven.missing.i: Not an oven yet: the inside must be hollow (layer %s).
message.realisticsurvival.food_poisoning: Your stomach turns. That food was bad.
message.realisticsurvival.salt_water: Sea water only makes you thirstier.
message.realisticsurvival.no_sea_water: That's sea water. Boil it dry in a cooking pot to get salt.
message.realisticsurvival.pot_salty: That's sea water. Keep it boiling until it's gone and scrape out the salt.
message.realisticsurvival.rack_shade: It will dry slowly in here. Hang it in the sun or over a campfire.
realisticsurvival.configuration.rawFoodR: Raw and bad food can make you ill
gui.realisticsurvival.mining.title: Mining
gui.realisticsurvival.mining.help.tap: Shift: tap (prises ore out, chips rock)
gui.realisticsurvival.mining.help.done: Enter: stop, keep what you got
message.realisticsurvival.getting_dull: Your %s is getting dull. Sharpen it with a whetstone.
Rub the mouse side to side, fast!
